scope: One-time public endpoint GET and feed metadata parsing from the KOL server. No production configuration, scheduler, subscription or application changes.

sources.note: https://feeds.bloomberg.com/markets/news.rss redirects to this canonical URL; these are one feed, not independent sources. Public RSS does not establish the coverage or latency of Bloomberg Event-Driven Feeds.

sources.access_verified: Public HTML entry point reachable; no RSS feed or structured article extraction established.
sources.official_free_api_status: Not confirmed. No stable official public free API/RSS documentation verified.

coverage_example.topic: LME copper price threshold alert; historical example, not current price or latency evidence.

limitations: A successful GET is a point-in-time connectivity check, not a long-term availability, automation permission or latency guarantee.
Feed entries provide metadata/descriptions; complete paid article text was not fetched or verified.
Publication time and the time an item first becomes available in a feed are different. A single probe cannot measure provider delivery delay.
WSJ feeds may overlap; item counts must not be added as unique stories. Multiple publishers can also repeat the same original report.

priority: 财联社 official structured access feasibility
proposed_next_step.processing: Commodity event ingestion independent of person-name searches; price/keyword rules can create factual cards before optional DeepSeek analysis. Keep Bing as supplementary discovery.
